Has the AI use-case been classified by risk level according to the EU AI Act and mapped for potential harms (legal, ethical, safety, privacy, security)?

How is human oversight and intervention designed into the AI system, particularly for high-risk applications?
Are processes in place for audit trails and record keeping to support regulatory reviews and internal accountability?
How is top management involved in supporting, directing, and overseeing AI policies and risk controls?
Is there a written AI governance policy and an AIMS aligned to ISO/IEC 42001?
